name: MonarchEmbeddedAppFrame
title: EmbeddedAppFrame
summary: A framed area that shows a screen owned by another app or module, such as another Rook app's settings page, with its loading and error states.
whenToUse: When a screen hosts content it does not own: another module's settings, a partner's page in a WebView, or a screen that may fail to load.
whenNotToUse: For content the screen owns, compose it directly. For a full-screen web page, open Custom Tabs.
api: @Composable fun MonarchEmbeddedAppFrame(title: String, state: MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameState, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, height: Dp? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onOpen: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameLabels = MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameLabels(), content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit)
enum class MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameState { Loading, Ready, Error }
class MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameLabels(loading: String? = null, errorTitle: String? = null, errorDescription: String? = null, retry: String? = null, open: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The name of what the frame shows, such as "Example Desk: Email notifications"; the frame's pane name.

options.name: state
options.description: Loading, Ready or Error, reported by the app.

options.name: height
options.description: A fixed height; null wraps the content, and loading and error keep at least 160dp.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Called by "Try again"; null hides it.

options.name: onOpen
options.description: Called by "Open the page" to open the screen outside the frame; null hides it.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Loading…", the error title and explanation, "Try again" and "Open the page".

options.name: content
options.description: The embedded screen, shown when ready: native content, or a WebView through AndroidView.

states.name: loading
states.description: A spinner and "Loading…" in the middle.

states.name: error
states.description: "This page didn’t open", the explanation, "Try again" and "Open the page".

appearance: The frame is the surface with the default border and the large radius; loading and error text is muted, the error title the default text. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web EmbeddedAppFrame is an iframe with a postMessage handshake (the App Settings embed contract): it detects readiness and resizes to the page height. Android has no iframe contract, so the app composes the content (natively, or a WebView it manages) and reports the state; there is no automatic timeout or resize. The web's "Open in a new tab" is "Open the page", and onOpen decides where it goes.
accessibility: The frame is a traversal group and a pane named by title.
While loading, the spinner is read as "Loading…".
The error title and explanation are read together as a polite live region; the buttons are separate with 48dp touch targets.
edgeCases: A fixed height smaller than the content clips it; the app scrolls inside.
Without onRetry and onOpen the error shows only its message.

examples.title: An embedded settings page (ready, auto-height)
A page that never answers
examples.setup:
var attempts by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
var opened by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
examples.code:
MonarchEmbeddedAppFrame(
    title = "Example Desk: Billing",
    state = MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameState.Error,
    height = 220.dp,
    onRetry = { attempts++ },
    onOpen = { opened = true },
    labels = MonarchEmbeddedAppFrameLabels(open = "Open in Example Desk"),
) {}
